description:
You are a cashier at a café that sells retail items alongside food service. A walk-in customer wants to purchase several items as a retail transaction (no table or delivery needed).

Your task:
1. On the main Floreant POS terminal screen, click the RETAIL button to start a new retail order.
2. Browse the available menu categories and add at least 3 distinct items to the order (e.g., a beverage, a side/appetizer, and a dessert).
3. Ensure one of the items has a quantity of 2 (so the total item count is at least 4).
4. Once all items are added, proceed to settle/pay the ticket.
5. Select CASH as the payment method and process the full payment to close the ticket.

The order should be fully settled and closed when you are done. Make sure you use the RETAIL order type.
